svg.title: IT: change approval
svg.desc: The change owner raises a request with scope, risk and a backout plan. The change manager assesses it. Standard changes are pre-approved and go straight to scheduling; normal changes go to the change advisory board, which approves them or sends them back for revision. The change manager schedules an approved change outside freeze periods. The implementer makes the change in its window and verifies it; a failed verification is backed out. The change manager reviews the result and closes the change.
svg.text: A change request is risk-assessed; standard changes are pre-approved, normal changes go to the change advisory board, and a failed verification is backed out.
Illustrative process. Lanes are roles; steps, thresholds and timings are examples, not policy.
